reader.requirement: At --std 85, when a RETURN finds a next record, the compiler must make the record available in the SD record area, then perform any INTO implicit move (subscripts of identifier-1 evaluated after the read, GR6b), and only then transfer control to the NOT AT END imperative-statement-2 when written, else to the end of the RETURN statement; the AT END imperative must not run. Covers fixed and variable-length (RECORD VARYING) SD records, INTO alphanumeric/group receivers, the forms with and without NOT AT END and END-RETURN.

edition-consulted.switches: construct conditional-phrases-any-order-2002 (COBOL0900): below 2002 NOT AT END written before AT END is refused; 2002+ accepts the reversed order

reader.edition-search: Read BindReturn and EmitReturn whole: neither consults the edition on the control-transfer path (ctx.Edition appears only as the argument of BoundRejected.Reported). grep for Edition|CobolVersion|Dialect in SortEmitter.EmitReturn region found none; the only edition arm on the RETURN path is the phrase-order gate in VersionConformancePass, reached through the shared conditionalPhrases rule.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for GR3's ordering of record-available, INTO move and transfer of control; yes for phrase order only: at 85 NOT AT END before AT END is refused (COBOL0900), at 2023 accepted (SR4)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf33_03 covers fixed-length SD, INTO alphanumeric, with and without NOT AT END; not exercised are a variable-length SD (DEPENDING item and group move), an INTO subscripted by the returned record, an INTO group receiver, a GO TO out of NOT AT END, and RETURN without END-RETURN

probes.printed: A-NAE[1ZZ   ][3] / A-END / B-NAE[2Q    ][2] / C-NAE[3ABCDE] / D-END[4XYZ][4] / E-ATEND[......] / E-END / DONE
probes.expected: varying SD: NOT AT END sees INTO receiver filled by a group move of the 3-char record and W-LEN=3; INTO W-E(SRT-K) lands in occurrence 2 (subscript after read, GR6b); GO TO from NOT AT END transfers; no-NOT-AT-END form continues after RETURN; at end NOT AT END ignored and INTO not done
INTO a group item receives the whole 6-char record before imperative-statement-2
subscript SRT-K is the value of the record just returned (2), so occurrence 2 receives 2Q

probes.printed: --std 85: error COBOL0900 ... RETURN statement writes AT END after NOT AT END, and its COBOL-85 general format prints AT END first; --std 2023: compiles, prints NAE
probes.expected: §1985:XI.4.3.2 prints AT END before NOT AT END and §1985:IV.2.1 requires that sequence; 2023 SR4 permits reversal

probes.printed: error COBOL1850: the AT END phrase is required on every RETURN statement and is omitted (85 and 2023)
probes.expected: AT END is unbracketed in §1985:XI.4.3.2; without it GR3's at-end destination does not exist

reader.notes: EmitReturn emits one if/else: the store's ReturnStatement test, then the record-area store, the DEPENDING restore, the INTO move, then NOT AT END, which is exactly GR3's order; the else arm holds AT END. Witness g85_bf33_03 MATCHes at 85. The run_probe.py named in the brief is absent from the pinned tree; probes ran through E:/COBOL/scripts/orchestrator/run_probe.py with --exe the pinned compiler.
